claim: Instead of hooking the original interrupt handler, select a second IM2 vector through I only while inside hooks, so the original handler runs during hook work without rewriting the original vector.

evidence.text: No hook on the handler: a second vector, selected by I inside hooks only.
I=23 selects the private vector only while page 24 is mapped; the original handler runs on a reserved private stack, and the original I and clock return before unmapping.
